name: ad-hene

attributes.attribute: Manx euphemism meaning 'themselves' for Otherworld spirits
people used ad-hene as a gentle name for the fairies
ad-hene is one of the euphemisms listed there

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: On the Isle of Man, people used the name ad-hene for the spirits of the Otherworld. The name means 'themselves'. The people avoided the true names of the fairies. They used gentle euphemisms instead. The term is one of several Names For The Fairies.
objective: Define the Manx euphemism ad-hene and its use for Otherworld spirits.
key_results: States the name is a euphemism for the fairies on the Isle of Man
Links the term to Names For The Fairies.
